items.title: Migrate document restore_version to RLS-scoped repository method
evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/documents.rs:1631 still calls the deprecated non-RLS document_repo.restore_version under #[allow(deprecated)] with a literal `// TODO: Migrate restore_version to RLS pattern`
The handler already takes `mut rls: RlsConnection` (it calls rls.release() in the Ok branch), so the RLS connection is in scope but unused for this write
document.rs:1873 deprecation note says `Use restore_version_rls` but that method does not exist; restore_version (1879) composes find_by_id (non-RLS) x2 + create_version (non-RLS) via self.pool
RLS primitives already exist to compose the variant: find_by_id_rls (document.rs:547) and create_version_rls (document.rs:1505)
PR #421 (2026-05-22) migrated the analogous market_pricing/notification_preferences/reports handlers using the identical `*_rls(&mut **rls.conn(), ...)` pattern

items.title: Triage + migrate remaining non-RLS tenant-scoped endpoints (budgets, lease_abstraction)
evidence: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/budgets.rs:1060 — dashboard query left non-RLS with a comment that it needs rewriting into a combined query over the RLS-aware connection
backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/budgets.rs:1513 — reserve-transaction path needs a new record_reserve_transaction_rls(...) repo method to run its multi-query transaction under RlsConnection

backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/lease_abstraction.rs:87/716/798 — upload/validate/import_to_lease handlers carry function-level #[allow(deprecated)] with no migration TODO; need triage to confirm whether tenant-scoped or deliberately context-free
Verified on origin/main 2026-05-23: the documents.rs/subscriptions.rs/auth.rs deprecated markers are deliberate (public or pre-auth/user-level endpoints), not migration candidates
Each item is a separate unit of work; budgets reserve-transaction requires new transactional repo plumbing so it is higher-risk than the restore_version one-liner
